name: Pensieve
summary: Pensieve should get a cautious T1 public-surface pass focused on visible claims, access friction, pricing clarity, and proof depth.

claims.claim: Homepage loads without login and value proposition is visible
claims.evidence: Homepage loads without login and the value proposition is visible: "Pensieve connects your tools into a living understanding of your organisation, so every interaction starts fully informed."

claims.claim: Primary agent capability is stated in concrete, testable terms
claims.evidence: Pensieve builds a structured knowledge graph of every person, project, decision, and customer, then distils it into curated domains, briefs, and mapped relationships.

claims.claim: Pricing or free/trial path is publicly discoverable
claims.evidence: Free during beta · No credit card required

claims.claim: Core workflow can be inspected from public docs, demo, templates, or repository
Trust, privacy, or data-handling claims are findable from public navigation
claims.evidence: Every AI action logged, every document versioned, every access controlled.

claims.claim: Competitor/differentiation claim is specific enough to verify
claims.evidence: Others connect to your data. Pensieve understands your business.

claims.claim: Public surface exposes at least one realistic scenario for the review engine
claims.evidence: "Write briefs, plans, and analyses with an AI copilot that already knows your team, customers, and strategy."
